methodology: A fixed, versioned list of atomic requirements for the owner's master directive. Each item is one measurable deliverable with one state. States: not_started; implemented (code or document merged); accepted (functional evidence: unit_test, db_test, build, browser, emulator, model_eval or device; docs_only and config_check never count); verified (integration-level evidence: db_test, browser, emulator, model_eval or device); device_validated (device evidence); blocked_external (cannot progress without something outside the software; blocked_by says what). Every file ref must exist and a PR ref must be #44 or later; acceptance and verification need a qualifying evidence item that names a file, not only a PR. Items are never removed to raise a percentage: blocked and not-started items stay in every denominator. A requirement that changes scope gets a new id and the version is raised. scripts/completion_summary.py enforces these rules and computes the seven measures.
